title: Does anyone else find it a bit unsettling that intelligent marine mammals have stopped showing up in many peoples dreams at around the same time that orcas started regularly attacking/ramming boats?

classification.theory_summary: Speculates that intelligent marine mammals (e.g., orcas) stopped appearing in many people's dreams around the same time orcas began ramming/attacking boats, possibly as a warning/alert.
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream narrative, locations, events, or phenomenological details are described—only speculative commentary about trends in others' dreams.

meta.author_theory: Speculation that intelligent marine mammals may be trying to warn/alert humans; notes perceived timing correlation between reduced dream appearances and real-world orca boat-ramming behavior.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains no first-person dream report or describable dream scene; only references a perceived change in others' dream content (marine mammals) and a real-world event (orcas ramming boats).
